uvUnits: u and v are in units of the atlas's WIDTH (v runs 0 … height / width): sample at (u, v x vScale). The atlas grew from 2048² to 2048 x 4096 on 8 Oct; every older uv names the same texels
pools: a tape item's `pool` (tape-jcard-blank / -mix, tape-spine-blank / -mix, tape-label): the room re-draws the tapes' prints per placement from their pool (apps/room/src/catalog/coverPools.ts)
note: the cover atlas (PROPS-PIPELINE.md P27): RGB, the slot cover-print shows its own colour; a tile is round(mm x pxPerMm) texels a side (an item's own pxPerMm where it carries one: the screens), wMm x hMm is the print's real size (the quad's); written by tools/props/covers/build.py, APPEND-ONLY (P15)
